description: AI-critical-infrastructure-predictive-maintenance: AI‑Driven Predictive Maintenance for Critical Infrastructure — v0.1.0 is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Friday Ogochukwu Ikwuogu (University of Texas of the Permian Basin). This release provides the initial, reproducible implementation of AI‑based predictive maintenance workflows for critical‑infrastructure systems. The project includes baseline machine‑learning models, structured preprocessing pipelines, and modular components designed for reliability engineering, anomaly detection, and early‑warning analytics. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
